known_limitations: The caller supplies a Python str; the internal encoded bytearray is wiped, but immutable caller-string memory cannot be guaranteed erased.
A hard interpreter/process/OS crash can leave the private sibling staging workspace; startup crash-residue recovery is not qualified in this package.
Cancellation kills the decrypt subprocess and prevents publish at stage boundaries, but delegated existing CBV extraction is not interrupted mid-subprocess by this wrapper.
Only .cbz is accepted by the secure execution primitive; .2cbz remains recognition/evidence-only because its general decrypt/payload contract is not qualified.
The primitive is not wired into Windows/NVDA actions or Library import and therefore is not an end-user feature.
Pinned upstream small.cbz is fixture/backend-mechanics evidence only and cannot promote format support.
support_unlock_still_requires: crash-residue recovery policy for decrypted staging material

trusted user-facing password entry with no persistence/logging/accessibility leakage
legal reusable real CBZ corpus with independent expected semantic oracle
